verdict.rationale: The docs name multiple selectable models, including nova-3 for recorded files and flux-general-multi for multilingual conversation, and a models-and-languages overview page describes model strengths such as domain-terminology comprehension. That shows a documented model choice. However, nothing in the pack publishes per-model accuracy figures, latency figures or per-model pricing; the only pricing evidence is generic pay-as-you-go credit. Missing for 10: published accuracy (e.g., WER) comparisons across models, documented latency tradeoffs per model, per-model cost tables, independent corroboration of the tradeoffs.
